caption: The drawing shows a dress with a high waist and very large, puffed sleeves that narrow at the wrists. The dress is predominantly purple with an intricate repeating pattern in green, white, and pale yellow. The bodice has buttons down the front, and the skirt is long and full. To the right of the main colored dress, there are two additional elements drawn in outline only: one is the same dress depicted from the back, and the other is a separate ruffled collar accessory. The background of the image is a plain cream or beige color. The main focus is on the detailed and vividly patterned dress at the center of the composition.
title: Dress
